```{r}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/election2016.csv"
election2016=read.csv(df_url)
head(election2016)
```

```{r}
set.seed(13)
n=nrow(election2016)
p=0.7
indices=sample(n,p*n)
train_set=election2016[indices,]
test_set=election2016[-indices,]
```

```{r}
fit_lm=lm(trump.vote~income.ineq,data=train_set) #Fit model to training
yhat=predict(fit_lm,test_set) #Predict test data
```

```{r}
n= nrow(election2016)
y=test_set$trump.vote #Actual test data responses
SSE=sum((y-yhat)^2)
MSE=SSE/n
RMSE=sqrt(MSE)
SST=sum((y-mean(y))^2)
R2=1-SSE/SST
cat("R^2 = ",R2, ", RMSE = ", RMSE)
data.frame(Metric=c("RMSE","R2"),Value=c(RMSE,R2))
```
